caseStudy.label: Featured Case Study
caseStudy.description: EFSG needed a more reliable and stable trading system as it expanded its digital ecosystem, where consistent quality and performance were critical. ATech assembled a full Scrum team from Hong Kong and Indonesia to deliver comprehensive quality assurance and testing services across their platforms, ensuring system functionality, stability, and performance were thoroughly validated throughout development. As a result, EFSG achieved a more robust and reliable trading environment with significantly improved software quality and reduced production issues.
